articles.summary: Micro-Emitter-Based, Pluggable Solution Targets Scale-Out and Front-End Connectivity Up to 50m with Copper-Class Reliability at Lower Power and Reduced Cable Bulk Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (Credo) (NASDAQ: CRDO), an innovator in providing connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions, today shared details of its 1.6T ZeroFlap active light cable (ALC), the industry’s first row-scale, wide-parallel optical interconnect solution built for AI scale-out and front-end networks. Credo's ZeroFlap Active Light Cable (ALC) is based on a dense array of micro-emitters and photodetectors coupled with flexible, lightweight fiber bundles, designed to draw 12W per cable-end in a pluggable form factor. With targeted reach up to 50m alongside 100 million hours mean time between failures (MTBF), Credo’s ZeroFlap ALC is designed to deliver the reliability, power efficiency, and reach required for next-generation AI infrastructure. articles.summary: Credo Demonstrates OmniConnect Running on AMD Versal™ Adaptive SoC Architecture to Offer System Integrators Terabyte-Class Memory Capacity and Bandwidth Without Waiting on Custom Silicon Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (Credo) (NASDAQ: CRDO), an innovator in providing connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions, today announced that it is showcasing high-performance memory scaling for programmable logic-based AI accelerators this week at the 2026 OCP Global Summit in San Jose. Credo will demonstrate its OmniConnect Weaver memory fanout gearbox in a programmable logic-based environment, enabling high memory bandwidth and high memory capacity on an AMD Versal™ AI Edge Series Gen 2 adaptive SoC evaluation board. The system puts memory capacity and bandwidth previously only reserved for custom ASICs within the reach of programmable logic.
